notes.title: The new game Scarlet Wolf is now available!
notes.content: [h2][i]Are you ready to step through that very door?[/i][/h2][p][/p][p][i]Beyond it lie endless corridors, traps, and a darkness that never sleeps.[/i][/p][p][i]Here your fears take shape, and every decision brings you closer either to salvation… or to demise.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Alex is reliving the same nightmare over and over. To break free, he turns to a psychologist for help—and together they dive into grim secrets of the past, where monsters aren’t always the main threat.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]💀 [i]In the game you’ll find:[/i][/h3][list][*][p][i]A rich atmosphere of horror and hopelessness[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unique monsters and character design[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Realistic sounds and an original soundtrack[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]A tense storyline with psychological themes[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Traps, escapes, and choices that decide your fate[/i][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔗 [i]Dive into the darkness now![/i][/h3]
